description_en: Queries the list of sound code label batches for a specified schedule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定排程的声码标签批次列表
name: QuerySoundCodeLabelBatchList

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the schedule
parameters.name: schedule_code

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回的时间段条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Valid values: 1 to 10000. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页。取值范围1~10,000，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

BatchCode.description_en: The unique identifier of the batch

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the batch was created

Status.description_en:
The batch status. Valid values:

RUNNING: Running.
SUCCESS: Succeeded.
PARTIAL_FAILED: Partially succeeded.
INTERRUPT: Interrupted
Status.description_zh:
批次状态。

RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCESS：成功。
PARTIAL_FAILED：部分成功。
INTERRUPT：中断

SuccessNum.description_en: The number of successfully created entries

Total.description_en: The total number of entries to be created in the batch

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页返回的时间段条数

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
Total.description_zh: 查询返回的时间段总条数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: sound code service has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
